Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>

Subject: MAP & Close Plan: MSA/DPA + Order Form Dependencies — Novaris Therapeutics

Lina / Novaris team —

Thanks again for the productive demo yesterday. Per our convo I put together a working Mutual Action Plan (attached) that aligns the evaluation gates, security evidence handoff, and legal milestones so we can hit a clean order-form signature window. Quick summary of the plan: 

- Target signature date: Sep 11, 2025 (proposed) — this assumes a two-week legal review and a three-week procurement approval after redlines are exchanged.
- Key dependencies: MSA redlines resolved -> DPA finalized -> Order form countersigned. All three must be complete before procurement issues PO.
- Security bar: SOC 2 Type II report + architecture/data flow diagram + test-data handling statement.
- Evaluation acceptance: two-week pilot, 5-day integration window, acceptance checklist to validate latency/service-levels. Owner for acceptance: Novaris QA (Diego Ramos).

Ask: can you confirm Novaris procurement's internal blackout dates in August and whether your legal team prefers tracked redlines or a marked-up doc? I attached an initial MAP draft (MAP-draft.pdf) and a short acceptance checklist.

If useful, I can set up a 30-minute triage with Laura and Karthik tomorrow to walk the MAP and call out any contract risks or gating options (e.g., phased order form to accelerate pilot).

Thanks —
Mateo Alvarez
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MAP-draft.pdf (application/pdf, 48KB)]
From: Lina Costa <lina.costa@novaris.ai>

Date: Tue, 29 Jul 2025 11:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: MAP & Close Plan: MSA/DPA + Order Form Dependencies — Novaris Therapeutics

Hi Mateo —

Appreciate the clear MAP. A couple quick notes from our side:

1) Legal prefers tracked redlines on the MSA (we'll do that once we have your redline baseline).
2) Procurement has an internal budget lock down Aug 10–20 for end-of-quarter approvals. If we can't get redlines in by Aug 3 they'll push signature to late Sep.
3) We need a data flow diagram and a brief runbook describing how PHI (if any) is handled during the pilot. Can you attach the runbook and confirm where logs will be stored/retained?

Diego will own acceptance testing and will schedule a short integration session with your engineer. We want to avoid multiple handoffs during the pilot; proposed pilot window: Aug 18–Aug 31 (two weeks) with a hard acceptance decision within 5 business days after the pilot ends.

I'll circulate an initial Novaris legal contact after a quick alignment internally — expect a name tomorrow.

Thanks,
Lina Costa
Head of Procurement | Novaris Therapeutics
[Attachment: Novaris-SOW-note.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, 22KB)]
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 Jul 2025 13:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: MAP & Close Plan: MSA/DPA + Order Form Dependencies — Novaris Therapeutics

Folks — forwarding Lina's reply. Quick notes from legal after a rapid skim: 

- We'll produce an MSA redline (MSA_redline_v1.docx) by EOD Friday (Aug 1) so Novaris has something to react to before their internal Aug 3 redline target.
- DPA: need to confirm data categories and a tentative retention schedule; lean toward a standard 90-day logs retention with customer-controlled deletion options.
- Suggested gating to accelerate: offer a phased order form for the pilot (limited seats, limited dataset) so procurement can issue a PO for the pilot while legal continues DPA negotiation. This reduces business friction and keeps the pilot on Aug 18–31.
- Risk flags: any PHI handling will require explicit DPA clauses and scoping of subprocessors. Also want a named escalation contact for security incidents.

Mateo — can you upload the runbook + data flow diagram and grant Laura & Karthik view access to the integration environment (staging.redwood)? We need at least one sample log-retention entry to validate the proposed 90-day policy.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MSA_redline_v1.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, 14KB)]

Lina / team —

Thanks — updated plan attached. Key adjustments:

- Moved target signature to Sep 11 only if Novaris legal can complete redline review by Aug 3; otherwise fallback target Sep 25.
- Added a phased-order-form option: pilot-only PO (up to 10 seats) to allow procurement to issue an initial PO while DPA wraps.
- Security deliverables: attached runbook and data flow diagram; logs retention policy proposed = 90 days (customer-controlled deletion upon request).
- Acceptance and ownership: Diego (Novaris) owner of acceptance, Redwood SRE (Grace) owner of staging access and sample logs.
- Checkpoints: 
  * Checkpoint 1 (Aug 1): Redwood sends MSA redline + runbook link.
  * Checkpoint 2 (Aug 14): Novaris confirms pilot window and procurement readiness.
  * Checkpoint 3 (Sep 11): Target signature / order-form countersign or fallback Sep 25.

I've attached the revised MAP checklist (MAP-revised-checklist.xlsx) and a simplified order-form template for review. If Novaris is OK with the phased PO approach I'll prepare a short DocuSign envelope to accelerate the pilot PO signing.

Next step: Lina, can we lock a 30-minute sync Fri 8/1 10am ET to walk the redline plan and onboarding steps? I'll send an invite once you confirm.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
